name: Line switch
summary: The device-function number used for a line-switching or disconnecting device in its documented application.
description: Device function number 89 identifies a line switch in the power-system device-function convention. The selected equipment and drawing context establish its actual operating duties and capabilities; the number is not a substitute for a switch specification.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the physical device associated with the reference.
Read switching, isolation and position information separately.
distinction: The number 89 and number 52 identify different device functions. A drawing reference does not establish equivalent interruption capability.
